report.summary: Examined chunk 5/10 of daedalus/council/vendors.py: defines _CLAUDE_DENIED_TOOLS, COUNCIL_PROFILES, _assert_profile_safe, and CouncilAdapter.__init__ and assemble. Verified claims about tool denial, profile safety, and adapter design against visible code.
risks: _CLAUDE_DENIED_TOOLS string | low | The denied tools string contains spaces but is used in f-string without quotes; may cause argument splitting issues. | Test with a profile that includes this argument and verify the command line is parsed correctly.

CouncilAdapter.assemble | medium | Claim that 'withholding is structural' and that adapter renders evidence blocks is uncheckable; method body not provided. | Review assemble implementation to confirm it enforces withholding.
CouncilAdapter.__init__ | low | Parameter 'cli_version' defaults to 'unknown' but may be passed as None; code sets self.cli_version = cli_version or 'unknown', which is safe. | No action needed.
COUNCIL_PROFILES | low | 'openai' profile uses '--ask-for-approval never' and '--skip-git-repo-check'; these flags are not verified against codex documentation. | Confirm codex supports these flags.

_assert_profile_safe | low | Uses FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS which is not defined in this chunk; safety check depends on external constant. | Ensure FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS is defined and contains appropriate fragments.

claims.text: ``--allowed-tools <tools...>`` would swallow the next flag if given an empty value, so the denial is expressed with the ``=`` form, which cannot slurp.
claims.why: The code uses f"--disallowed-tools={_CLAUDE_DENIED_TOOLS}" with = form, matching the claim.

claims.text: No --permission-mode at all (dontAsk is what the runtime profile carries), tools denied, MCP pinned to the empty --mcp-config set.
claims.why: The anthropic profile has args that include --disallowed-tools and --strict-mcp-config without --permission-mode; comment describes intent and matches visible args.

claims.text: read-only sandbox + approvals never; --skip-git-repo-check because the council cwd is a bare temp dir by design and codex otherwise refuses.
claims.why: The openai profile args include --ask-for-approval never, --sandbox read-only, --skip-git-repo-check, matching the comment.

claims.text: A refusal is a STATUS, not an exception -- a council must never lose a participant to a traceback, because a missing turn is indistinguishable from a turn that was never sought.
claims.why: The claim about mapping failures onto STATUSES and not raising exceptions refers to behavior not visible in this chunk (ask method not present).

claims.text: The adapter -- not the caller -- renders the evidence blocks, because a gate that only REPORTS withheld paths while the caller ships the bytes anyway is worse than no gate.
claims.why: The implementation of assemble is not provided; only signature and docstring are present.

observations.what: _CLAUDE_DENIED_TOOLS is a single string with spaces after commas; used in f-string as is, may cause argument splitting if shell interprets it.
COUNCIL_PROFILES is a module-level dict iterated over with _assert_profile_safe, which uses FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS not defined in this chunk.
CouncilAdapter.__init__ accepts cli_version defaulting to 'unknown' but also handles None with 'or' clause; safe but redundant.
CouncilAdapter.assemble method signature includes evidence_paths, evidence_files, withheld but implementation not shown.
openai profile uses '--ask-for-approval never' and '--skip-git-repo-check'; these flags are not verified against codex documentation.
